title: ExtensionInfo
description: An extension of the server (since 1.13): an OSGi bundle in the extensions folder.

jar.description: The name of its JAR file, the id of the extension in the calls.

state.description: The OSGi state: INSTALLED, RESOLVED, STARTING, STOPPING, ACTIVE, UNINSTALLED.

stopped.description: Whether the administrator stopped it (it stays stopped after a restart).

loaded.description: Whether the server loaded it as an extension.

valid.description: Whether it fits this version of the server, null when it was not checked.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its JAR (hex), null when it could not be read.
